title: The Link resource forwarded caller-supplied ping beacons

examples: Render Link with ping=https://collector.invalid/ping and activate the link.
The component spread all remaining AnchorHTMLAttributes onto its anchor, which included ping.
reproduction.beforeFix: The 324-resource source scan returned a failure after SEC-37-101 was added because Link's ...rest spread could forward an unbounded ping prop. The scanner correctly refused to certify that anchor spread.
reproduction.browserEvidence: The SEC-37-101 Chromium probe confirmed that activating an anchor with ping=https://collector.invalid/ping emits an outbound beacon; Playwright intercepted and aborted that request.

rootCause: The public Link primitive forwarded the complete native anchor prop rest object, including the hidden outbound ping attribute.
remediation: Remove ping from the Link type contract and strip a runtime ping value before forwarding the remaining anchor props. Teach the static gate to recognize an explicit exclusion in a rest binding while continuing to reject unresolved ping spreads.

validation.redBeforeFix: pnpm exec vitest run packages/registry-gate/src/__tests__/registry-gate.test.ts -t "anchor rest props only when the ping beacon is explicitly stripped"
validation.redBeforeFixResult: failed as expected: a safe rest binding with explicit ping exclusion was reported as uncertified
validation.targetedAfterFix: pnpm exec vitest run packages/registry-gate/src/__tests__/registry-gate.test.ts -t "anchor rest props only when the ping beacon is explicitly stripped|hidden outbound link ping beacons|scheme-relative and scheme-only forms"
validation.targetedAfterFixResult: 3 tests passed; unfiltered anchor rest props fail closed, explicitly excluded ping passes, and remote ping examples remain rejected
validation.catalogBuild: pnpm build:catalog passed and regenerated the published Link registry item

runtimeBoundary: The browser request probe demonstrating the beacon was intercepted before network access. The post-fix code removes ping before anchor prop forwarding; no external request was sent.
